name: Azhar
title: AI Automation Specialist
summary: I build intelligent AI automation systems that eliminate repetitive work and help businesses scale. From AI agents to complex workflow automation, I design systems that are reliable, documented, and built to last.
story: My journey into AI automation started with a simple frustration — watching talented teams waste hours on repetitive manual work that could be automated.
